Priya (CS): Hey team — Nebula Analytics renewal landed. Procurement wants PO# NA-2024-900 and bank wire instructions to be present on the invoice. Also asked whether the contract can switch to MRR (monthly) instead of annual prepay. They say treasury prefers monthly for forecasting.
Jamal (AE): Hmm, pricing model change mid-renewal is a material change. We can offer a transitional MRR at a 5% premium vs annual prepay; will confirm with RevOps. @Keiko, will accounting accept a monthly invoice flow?
Keiko (Finance): We can do monthly invoicing but require net30 on each invoice. Also need beneficiary name + routing + SWIFT on file before we can wire. Ask them for bank details and a W-8BEN-E (they're outside US).
Priya (CS): Nebula requested a delayed start (contract effective date +30 days) to align with their next quarter. Legal flagged potential proration impacts. @Nora can we include a proration clause?
Nora (Legal): Yes — include a proration/credit schedule. Also need to confirm there are no export-control issues on the features in scope (they'll fill the export-control checkbox). I'll add an export-control warranty and an acceptance clause for Webhooks.
OnboardingBot: Onboarding checklist created: NBULA-ONB-742 — tracks SSO, webhook delivery, sample payloads, and data residency.
Jamal (AE): Another ask: they want the invoice billed to "Nebula Analytics UK Ltd" but signatures by Nebula US parent. Procurement insists invoice entity must match PO entity. Can we route billing to the UK entity while signing with US parent?
Keiko (Finance): Not without an intercompany agreement. If they insist, we need a reseller/addendum. Otherwise require the PO match the signing entity.
Priya (CS): Customer willing to provide reseller agreement. I'll request the signed reseller addendum and the bank + tax docs. Timeline: they want to close the week.
Nora (Legal): Drafting addendum now. I'll include: (1) reseller/addendum reference, (2) proration schedule for delayed effective date, (3) export-control checkbox language, (4) invoice entity mapping clause that requires either matching PO or a signed reseller addendum.
Jamal (AE): I pinged their treasury for bank details and the W-8. Also asked for the named accounting contact: finance+payables@nebula-uk.com.
Priya (CS): Onboarding asks for webhook callback URL to whitelisted: https://hooks.nebula-uk.com/redwood. They also want a shared secret for HMAC verification.
OnboardingBot: Note: webhook secret to be provisioned after SSO prod cutover. SSO currently in pilot.
Keiko (Finance): For monthly billing we'll need a billing cadence section on the contract and payment terms net30. Also add bank details to invoice template: \n```\nBeneficiary: Nebula Analytics UK Ltd (as invoiced)\nAccount: ****1234\nSWIFT: NBUKGB21\nBank: First Bridge Bank\n```
Priya (CS): I'll collect artifacts: reseller addendum, W-8BEN-E, bank file, and the PO. If they provide everything by EOD Friday we can hit their target close.
Nora (Legal): Envelope EN-10244 created for Nebula — includes reseller addendum + modified SOW + proration clause. Waiting for signature from "Head of Legal - Nebula US" and "Finance Director - Nebula UK".
Jamal (AE): Quick check: do we need a separate billing contact in the Console for UK invoices? Priya, please add finance+payables@nebula-uk.com to the billing contacts.
Priya (CS): Done. Added contact and flagged the renewal row in the tracker: https://redwood.atlassian.net/renewals/NEBULA-27
Keiko (Finance): If they switch to MRR we need RevOps to update ARR recognition. Jamal, loop in RevOps so revenue ops can scope the transitional uplift.
Jamal (AE): On it — CC'ing RevOps.
Priya (CS): Thanks team. I'll push for the docs and update this thread with any artifacts. If they miss EOD Friday, we'll revert pricing to standard annual terms. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
